description: Stand up a rogue/evil-twin access point to harvest credentials — WPA2-Enterprise PEAP-MSCHAPv2 challenge/response and captive-portal capture. Load on an authorized wireless engagement targeting WPA-Enterprise (802.1X) or a portal-based network. Signals: PEAP/EAP/802.1X, RADIUS, "enterprise Wi-Fi", eaphammer/hostapd-wpe in play, a captive portal, corporate SSID with per-user logins.
